prompt: Provide the `AndroidManifest.xml` intent-filter configuration for handling custom scheme deep links into the app.
raw_response:
AndroidManifest.xml
```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    package="com.example.app">

    <application
        android:allowBackup="false"
        android:fullBackupContent="@xml/backup_rules"
        android:supportsRtl="true">

        <activity
            android:name=".DeepLinkActivity"
            android:exported="true"
            android:taskAffinity=""
            android:launchMode="singleTask">

            <!-- Custom scheme deep link: myapp://host/path -->
            <intent-filter android:autoVerify="false">
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.VIEW" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.DEFAULT" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.BROWSABLE" />
                <data android:scheme="myapp" android:host="host" />
            </intent-filter>

        </activity>

    </application>
</manifest>
```

Security-relevant decisions:
- `android:exported="true"` required for external invocation; `android:taskAffinity=""` prevents task hijacking; `singleTask` ensures one instance handles all links via `onNewIntent`.
- `android:allowBackup="false"` excludes secure stores from backup.
- Intent-filter uses exact `scheme` + `host` (no wildcards); `autoVerify="false"` because custom schemes cannot be verified.
- Deep link handling logic (parsing, allowlist, schema validation, no mutation) lives in `DeepLinkActivity` per §4 rules.
